evidence: Labeled Mining and updates interfaces::Mining, BlockAssembler coinbase logic, and block template validation.
rationale: Introduces a bandwidth-efficient template reconstruction interface for external mining coordinators. As noted in the description, Stratum v2 Job Declarator Servers currently must 'maintain a duplicate mempool mirror outside Bitcoin Core' and repeatedly poll full templates; TxCollection enables external coordinators to reconstruct and validate templates against Core's mempool and tip without maintaining redundant mirrors.
